meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 为项目添加 DeltaChat 渠道适配器:消息走邮箱并带端到端加密,附件双向可用;启动时记录邀请链接并写出 QR 码 SVG,IMAP 长时间静默或断连时会重启 IO。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 项目接入 DeltaChat 渠道、运行 add-deltachat,或提到邀请链接、DC_EMAIL 等配置时接管。

say.text: 给这个项目加上 DeltaChat 渠道
say.note: 会复制适配器并安装 RPC 依赖包

say.text: 把 DeltaChat 的邀请链接和二维码发我
say.note: 链接记在日志里,QR 写入 dc-account/

say.text: 发送这张图并配文 /set-avatar 换头像
say.note: 只有 owner 或 admin 角色可用

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat channel adapter to your project: messages go over email with end-to-end encryption, attachments work both ways, and the invite link plus a QR SVG are logged at startup.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to add a DeltaChat channel to a NanoClaw project, run add-deltachat, or mention the invite link or DC_EMAIL settings.

say_en.text: Add the DeltaChat channel to this project
say_en.note: copies the adapter, installs the RPC package

say_en.text: Show me the DeltaChat invite link and QR code
say_en.note: link is in the log, QR in dc-account/

say_en.text: Send this image with the /set-avatar caption
